title: Document jmap: URI ban in link spans and E2EE
description:
Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[chat-core] Document link-span and E2EE restriction on jmap: object URIs
Spec (42c244b): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L1563: "`\"link\"` | `uri` (String) | Hyperlink; `uri` SHOULD be treated as untrusted, and MUST NOT be a JMAP object URI ({{JMAP-OBJECT-URI}}), because `body` is relayed between servers unchanged"; L1813: "a client MUST NOT place one in encrypted content; a client that finds one after decryption treats it as unresolvable."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/rich.rs:114 (Span::uri doc: "MUST be treated as untrusted" only)
Now: Span::uri doc omits the jmap: prohibition (and overstates untrusted as MUST; spec says SHOULD). No client span builder or E2EE code exists, so no behavior to change.
Change: Doc-only: add that a link uri MUST NOT be a JMAP object URI (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Rich Body). No server enforcement is required (see decisions).
notes: Mark 2026-10-20 DECISION: doc-only client rule; server does not parse bodies to reject jmap: link spans.
close_reason: Batch 8b: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed on main), see commit trailer
